test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All hens are chickens.

All chickens are eggs.

Conclusions:

(I) All hens are eggs.

(II) All eggs are chickens.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c47abb193e5587d98bef8be7f692f6004050cd0c655d97eb9f3efba01f929374.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All hens are eggs → Follow (As all hens are chickens and all chickens are eggs. As whole hens comes in chickens which whole comes in eggs, therefore it is true.)

(II) All eggs are chickens → Does not follow (As all chickens are eggs. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
